overview.about: IFA Berlin is Europe's largest consumer-electronics and home-appliance show, a tradition dating back to 1924. Held each September at the Messe Berlin fairgrounds, it is where major brands reveal their autumn line-ups of TVs, audio, appliances and smart-home tech.
overview.nextEvent: The next IFA Berlin is held in September at Messe Berlin. It combines a huge trade exhibition with public days, and its product launches set the tone for the pre-holiday electronics season in Europe.

@graph.name: IFA Berlin
@graph.description: IFA Berlin is one of Europe’s long-running consumer-electronics fairs, held at Messe Berlin in the city’s Charlottenburg district. Brands use its exhibition halls and stage programme to demonstrate home appliances, entertainment technology and connected devices. The 2026 show spans five days, making the U-Bahn access to Messe Berlin more useful for visitors than treating the fair as a single product launch.
